contests.title: Founder Funding Story Challenge — Season 1
contests.summary: Tell us how your business used (or tried to use) a government scheme — PMEGP, Mudra, CGTMSE, ODOP, CMEGP or any state scheme. The most useful, honest stories win and get featured so other founders learn from them.
contests.prize: Cash prizes + featured founder profile — prize pool announced at launch
contests.who: Indian founders, MSME owners and self-employed professionals (18+)
contests.timeline: Entries open soon · results announced on this page

contests.title: Scheme Smart Quiz — Monthly
contests.summary: A 10-question skill quiz on government business schemes, eligibility and documents. Highest score in the shortest time wins; ties are broken by time taken.
contests.prize: Monthly winner prizes — announced with each round
contests.who: Students, founders, CA/CS/MBA aspirants and finance professionals (18+)

contests.title: District Champion Challenge
contests.summary: Help MSMEs in your district discover schemes they qualify for. Champions who bring verified, consenting businesses to a free assessment earn rewards and a featured profile.
contests.prize: Rewards per verified referral + quarterly top-champion prize
contests.who: Students, CSC operators, CAs, bank-mitras and community leaders (18+)
